messages.content: The display-case work has slipped. Final object placement is now Thursday morning, so I need to stay Wednesday night and move my return from Wednesday to Thursday. Do not touch the Monday flight. I should be released around noon Thursday.

I’ll leave Monday’s confirmed ATL-STL flight unchanged and check Thursday nonstop returns that allow time to leave the museum after noon. I’ll also look first for an additional night at the Drury Plaza, then compare a nearby hotel if extending the stay would require an impractical room change.
That’s right. What can you find?

For Thursday, July 23, Delta has a nonstop leaving STL at 3:42 p.m. and arriving in Atlanta at 6:19 p.m. Changing only the return from your confirmed Wednesday flight adds $84.00; the ticket remains Main Cabin. A 1:35 p.m. nonstop is also available, but it would be tight after a noon release and airport travel. The later nonstop options begin at 7:46 p.m.
Use the 3:42 option. Is an aisle seat open?
Yes. Standard Main Cabin aisle seats are currently open on the 3:42 p.m. flight, including 19C and 21D. No seat change fee is shown. I have not modified the ticket yet.
Good. What about Wednesday night at the Drury?

The same room type from your existing reservation is sold out for Wednesday night. The hotel can add a Deluxe King for July 22-23 at $229.82 including taxes. Staff can link the reservations and note a request to keep you in the same room, but they cannot guarantee that; you may need to move rooms Wednesday morning. The nearby Hyatt Regency has a King room for $248.17 including taxes, which would require changing hotels.
I would rather stay at the Drury and accept the possible room move. Before you confirm anything, give me the revised trip total and make sure the old Wednesday flight value is being applied.

The original confirmed trip total was $856.64, including the two hotel nights and the ground-transportation allowance. The airline is applying the full value of the Wednesday return to the Thursday flight, leaving only the $84.00 fare difference. Adding the third Drury night at $229.82 brings the revised total to $1,170.46. There are no separate change or seat fees. The added hotel night is cancellable until 6:00 p.m. local time on July 21.
So the increase is $313.82, and nothing on Monday changes?

Correct. The increase is $313.82: $84.00 for the return-flight difference plus $229.82 for Wednesday night. Your Monday 6:18 p.m. ATL-STL nonstop remains unchanged, as do the first two nights at the Drury Plaza and the transportation allowance.
All right. Change the return to Thursday at 3:42 p.m. with 19C, and book the extra Drury night. Link it to the existing stay.

Both changes are confirmed. Delta confirmation D8K2QF now has the unchanged Monday 6:18 p.m. ATL-STL flight and a Thursday, July 23 return departing STL at 3:42 p.m., arriving ATL at 6:19 p.m.; seat 19C is assigned, and the collected fare difference was $84.00. Drury confirmation DRY-723591 adds July 22-23 in a Deluxe King for $229.82 and is linked to your existing reservation. The hotel has recorded the request to keep you in the same room, but a room move remains possible. The revised trip total is $1,170.46.
